integrity: The continuous optimization is reduced analytically to a finite spectral problem for order-five skew sign matrices. The finite classification and equality orbit are exhaustively checked by exact integer enumeration. Numerical approximation is not used to establish the theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only real five-vector Parseval frames in dimension two and total 2-volume. It does not give a general formula for other lengths, dimensions, fields, or volume orders. A differently phrased prior result in exterior-algebra or skew-tournament literature remains a residual originality risk.
title: The regular pentagon uniquely maximizes total \(2\)-volume for five-vector Parseval frames in \(\mathbb R^2\)
